items.title: Should You Buy Elevance Health Stock For The Margin It Lost?
items.summary: Elevance Health (ELV) has returned more than 40% over the past six months, though it is down 6.5% over the past three while the S&P 500 gained 3.4%. The next leg will not come from selling more insurance. It will come from keeping more of the premium it already collects.

items.title: Why Is UNH Stock Trading At A Premium With The Slowest Growth?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) runs the best operating margin of the three managed care companies in its peer group, and the slowest revenue growth of the three. It also carries a significant valuation premium over its peer, Cigna, trading at more than double its earnings multiple.

items.title: 3 Value Stocks with Questionable Fundamentals
items.summary: The low valuation multiples for value stocks provide a margin of safety that growth stocks rarely offer. However, the challenge lies in determining whether these cheap assets are genuinely undervalued or simply on sale due to their potentially deteriorating business models.
